name: Cable Straight-Arm Pulldown
steps: Stand facing a high pulley with feet hip-width apart and grip the bar overhand above shoulder height.
Step back slightly and hinge mildly at your hips until the cable is taut and your torso is braced.
Sweep the bar down in a wide arc toward your thighs while holding a slight bend in your elbows.
Squeeze your lats briefly at the bottom, then raise the bar back overhead under control.
tips: Keep your ribs down as you reach toward the pulley.
Keep your elbow angle fixed so your lats do the work rather than your triceps.
